hyperedges.label: Automated Deployment Flow (GitHub + Dokploy on Hetzner)
Montar Web Build Pipeline (wizard → API → orchestrator → project)
Live Preview System (SSR of real components)
Flujo de publicacion: Montar web -> orquestador -> Dokploy -> Cloudflare DNS -> SSL

nodes.label: Builder → GitHub → Dokploy Flow
nodes.rationale: Target flow: build a site in the builder, press 'Montar web', and get an independent project on the Desktop, pushed to GitHub and deployed to a Hetzner VPS via Dokploy.

nodes.label: Dokploy
nodes.rationale: Self-hosted deploy panel on the Hetzner VPS; automated via API key (x-api-key header) with environment ID, optional server ID, and a GitHub Provider ID so pushes redeploy automatically.

nodes.label: GitHub Token / gh CLI Auth
nodes.rationale: Fine-grained PAT (Administration + Contents read/write) recommended for repo creation and push; the orchestrator falls back to an authenticated gh CLI when GITHUB_TOKEN is absent. Token must be exported in the same terminal that runs npm run dev because the API inherits that environment.

nodes.label: Dokploy API Deploy Sequence
nodes.rationale: Full automation calls, in order: application.create → application.saveGithubProvider → application.saveBuildType (Dockerfile) → application.saveEnvironment → domain.create (HTTPS Let's Encrypt) → application.deploy.

nodes.label: Productized Web Packages
nodes.rationale: Sell packages (Presencia 390-590€, Negocio 790-1.200€, Premium 1.500-2.500€) instead of 'a website'; price is set by value to the client, not hours, because the builder collapses production time to hours.

nodes.label: Maintenance + Hosting Recurring Revenue
nodes.rationale: 25-50€/month per site while real VPS cost is cents per site (all on one Hetzner server with Dokploy); 20 clients = 500-1.000€/month passive. Billed via Stripe subscription; includes domain, SSL, backups, capped content changes and an automatic monthly Plausible traffic report.

nodes.label: Speed as Sales Argument (48h web)
nodes.rationale: 'Your web ready in 48h' differentiates against month-long agencies; the builder preview lets you show the client their branded site in the first meeting and close the sale live.

nodes.label: Niche Recipe Templates
nodes.rationale: Specialize by sector (hairdressers, dental clinics, restaurants, lawyers…) with one base recipe per niche and semi-written sector copy stored in recipes/; sharpens marketing, enables word-of-mouth within the trade, and makes each site even faster.

nodes.label: Natural Upsells
nodes.rationale: Legal page, Google Business + reviews, professional email, monthly local SEO / Google Ads, Cal.com bookings, and an optional light CMS (Decap/TinaCMS) as a 'edit it yourself' upsell.

nodes.label: Automatic RGPD/LSSI Legal Page
nodes.rationale: Legally required in Spain (RGPD/LSSI); generating it automatically from business data unblocks selling to any Spanish business without risk — it is roadmap item #1 in BUSINESS_IDEAS and pending item #3 in PLAN.

nodes.label: Lovable Master Prompt Template
nodes.rationale: Fill-in-the-blanks master prompt (business data, exact palette hexes, typography, page structure, key content, SEO, functionality, quality bar) usable manually or auto-filled from the current recipe via the 'Copiar prompt Lovable' button. Paste it whole in the first message — Lovable works best with all info at once — and remind it of the exact hexes if it drifts.

nodes.label: Lovable (AI web builder)
nodes.rationale: External AI builder used as an alternative production path (React + Tailwind); export by connecting GitHub from Lovable and cloning the repo, then deploy on Dokploy like builder projects by adding a Dockerfile like the one in scripts/build-site.mjs.

nodes.label: Astro Lego Builder v2 Plan
nodes.rationale: Business goal: create client websites in minutes, not days; after generation only content/logo personalization remains before billing. All 6 redesign phases executed and verified end-to-end as of 5 July 2026.

nodes.label: Receta v2
nodes.rationale: Multi-page recipe schema (src/data/recipeSchema.ts): types plus presets for themes, palettes, fonts and page templates; the reproducible JSON contract that flows from wizard to API to orchestrator and is saved into each generated project as site.recipe.json.

nodes.label: Component Registry
nodes.rationale: src/data/componentRegistry.ts maps ~100 real components across 9 themes with per-theme fallbacks so any theme can render any section category.

nodes.label: Component Module Map
nodes.rationale: src/data/componentMap.ts uses import.meta.glob to resolve component variants at render time for the preview.

nodes.label: SiteBuilder Wizard
nodes.rationale: src/components/automation/SiteBuilder.tsx: 10-step wizard with live preview, saved recipes, validation, and the 'Montar web' trigger.

nodes.label: Preview SSR
nodes.rationale: src/pages/preview.astro server-renders the real component library with the recipe passed via query param, shown as an iframe inside the builder (uses @astrojs/node adapter).

nodes.label: Build Jobs API
nodes.rationale: src/pages/api/build.ts: POST launches the build in background (spawns the orchestrator), GET returns progress; per-job logs stored in .builder-jobs/<job>/log.jsonl.

nodes.label: Orquestador build-site
nodes.rationale: scripts/build-site.mjs: generates the project, runs npm install, initializes git, creates the GitHub repo and wires Dokploy (app + domain + deploy). Legacy v1 scripts live in scripts/legacy/.

nodes.label: Color Utils (hex → HSL scale)
nodes.rationale: src/utils/colors.ts converts hex to HSL and expands it into a Tailwind 50-700 scale so a single picked color becomes a full palette.

nodes.label: Lovable Prompt Generator
nodes.rationale: src/utils/lovablePrompt.ts generates the Lovable prompt from the current recipe; exposed as a button in the wizard's final step.

nodes.label: Component Library (9 themes × 11 categories)
nodes.rationale: ~100 real components in 9 themes (modern, minimalist, creative, corporate, saas, cleantech, elegante, glass, terminal) across 11 section categories; ~440-468 empty AI-generated numbered files were deleted during cleanup. Only ~1/3 of components accept props yet — parametrizing heroes/CTAs is the top pending priority.

nodes.label: CSS Variables HSL Theming
nodes.rationale: Theming via HSL CSS variables (--color-primary-500…) mapped in Tailwind to primary-*/secondary-*/accent-* so the builder palette converts automatically into a full scale applied live to the preview and baked into generated projects.

nodes.label: Receta JSON
nodes.rationale: La receta es reproducible: cada web generada incluye su site.recipe.json para regenerarla o clonarla, y las recetas guardadas en recipes/ sirven como plantillas por cliente/nicho.

nodes.label: Proyectos generados
nodes.rationale: Cada web sale como proyecto Astro 5 independiente (React solo si hay navbars interactivas, para minimizar peso) con Dockerfile + nginx.conf listos para Dokploy en puerto interno 80, de modo que el deploy no requiere configuracion adicional.

nodes.label: Guia completa desde 0
nodes.rationale: Guia unica de referencia: la primera vez tarda ~1 hora por cuentas y tokens; a partir de la segunda web, minutos.

nodes.label: Token de GitHub (fine-grained)
nodes.rationale: Fine-grained token con permisos Administration (crear repos) y Contents (push) sobre todos los repositorios; debe exportarse en la MISMA terminal que arranca el builder porque Montar web hereda ese entorno.

nodes.label: GitHub Provider ID de Dokploy
nodes.rationale: Necesario para el auto-deploy por push: Dokploy debe estar conectado a GitHub via su GitHub App con acceso a los repos usados; si falta, el push no redespliega.

nodes.label: Cloudflare DNS
nodes.rationale: Registros A (@ y www) apuntando a la IP del VPS Hetzner con proxy en nube GRIS (DNS only) hasta que el SSL este emitido, porque con el proxy naranja Let's Encrypt no puede validar el dominio desde Dokploy. Recomendacion: comprar los dominios de los clientes en Cloudflare Registrar (precio de coste) y cobrarlos en la cuota anual para controlar el DNS sin depender del cliente.

nodes.label: SSL Let's Encrypt
nodes.rationale: Si el certificado fallo por probar antes de la propagacion DNS, se borra y recrea el dominio en Dokploy (o redeploy); tras emitirse se puede activar el proxy naranja con SSL/TLS Full (strict).

nodes.label: Widgets (Crisp, Tawk.to, Cal.com/Calendly, Google Maps, script custom)
nodes.norm_label: widgets (crisp, tawk.to, cal.com/calendly, google maps, script custom)

nodes.label: Personalizar la web generada
nodes.rationale: Mapa de personalizacion: config.ts (datos negocio), theme.css (colores), global.css (fuentes), Layout.astro (SEO/widgets/cookies/idiomas), componentes (textos), public/images (fotos con mismo nombre = cero cambios); git push redespliega solo via Dokploy.

nodes.label: Roadmap: mejoras, implementaciones e ideas
nodes.rationale: Prioridades: ya (parametrizar componentes, recetas por nicho, formulario onboarding) para afinar el ciclo venta-entrega; este mes (textos IA, subir logo, schema.org) para que la web salga casi terminada; con clientes (informe mensual, panel de flota, Stripe) para que el recurrente se gestione solo.

nodes.label: Parametrizar textos en todos los componentes
nodes.rationale: Mejora numero 1: hoy solo ~1/3 de los componentes acepta props y el resto lleva texto demo; parametrizar reduce la edicion manual post-generacion.
nodes.norm_label: parametrizar textos en todos los componentes

nodes.label: Galeria de recetas por nicho
nodes.rationale: Recetas semi-escritas por sector (peluqueria, clinica, restaurante, abogado) para acortar el ciclo venta-entrega.

nodes.label: Kit de onboarding (formulario Tally)
nodes.rationale: El cliente rellena textos, fotos y gustos en un formulario que mapea 1:1 con los pasos del builder, eliminando fricciones de recogida de contenido.

nodes.label: Generacion de textos con IA
nodes.rationale: Rellenar hero, servicios, FAQ y meta descriptions desde la descripcion del negocio para que la web salga casi terminada del builder.

nodes.label: Panel de flota
nodes.rationale: Lista de todas las webs generadas con estado del deploy, dominio, SSL y ultimo push, para gestionar la cartera cuando haya clientes.

nodes.label: Informe mensual automatico
nodes.rationale: Visitas de Plausible enviadas por email al cliente: justifica la cuota de mantenimiento mensual.

nodes.label: Cuota de mantenimiento 25-50 EUR/mes
nodes.rationale: Hosting, dominio, SSL y cambios menores: 'el verdadero negocio' es el ingreso recurrente, no el proyecto puntual.
